subject: Presentation-layer host slot (PageChrome.host) so v2 stops reaching into export.css
description:
APPROVED by the owner 2026-08-27. Ready to start; no decision outstanding.

Problem: `claude-monitor-v2` positions itself using the RENDERER's internal selectors — it
pads `body`, offsets `#topbar`, and nudges `#newbadge`, having learned from
claude-replay-html/src/html/export.css that `.layout` centres itself. That knowledge lives
outside the crate that owns the layout, so an `export.css` restructure misaligns v2 SILENTLY.
This is the one place a fork of the presentation layer could start by accident.

Fix: add an opaque host slot to `PageChrome` (in claude-replay-html/src/html_export/mod.rs) —
an inset the host asks for, plus a `data-shell` attribute on `<body>` — and move the offsets
into `export.css` beside the layout they offset. v2 (claude-monitor-v2/src/shell.html) then
asks for the slot instead of reaching in.

Follow the pattern `PageChrome::host_search` already set: the renderer hides or repositions
its OWN control, rather than the host reaching in with a selector.

Purely additive and inert for v1: existing callers pass no chrome, so `--dump-html` output
must stay byte-identical. That is the acceptance test, alongside the browser harness
(claude-replay-browser-tests) still passing for v2's fixed-rail layout.
outcome: PageChrome gained host_inset: Option<u32> — a left inset in CSS PIXELS, not a CSS string, because PageChrome is built from query parameters and a raw length would be a CSS-injection surface on a page holding the monitor's cookie. It stamps data-shell + --host-inset on <body>, clamped to MAX_HOST_INSET (2000). The three offsets moved from claude-monitor-v2/src/shell.html into export.css as body[data-shell] rules, beside the layout they offset; v2 now owns ONE number (RAIL_W, substituted into its own stylesheet as {{RAIL_W}} and passed as the inset), so the page's offsets and the rail they clear can no longer drift. Byte gate re-baselined: a pure 17-line insertion of the new CSS, identical in all five fixtures, nothing removed. Ships in v1.119.0.

log.msg: Fixing this exposed that the v2 browser assertion had been DEAD since pairing landed, for two independent reasons: /api/sessions 401s unpaired (the test set no state dir and never paired), and the listing shape changed from {sessions:[...]} to {groups:[{rows:[...]}]} when v2 started sharing v1's Index. Both failures fell into the same silent 'skip: no sessions on this machine' branch. The test now runs with its own CLAUDE_MONITOR_STATE + --pair, bootstraps the cookie through ?token=, reads the current shape, and asserts the listing parses rather than folding an auth regression into the skip. Verified load-bearing: with host_inset:None it fails on streamOffset.
